plainText:
Mayumi Iizuka (Japanese: 飯塚雅弓 Iizuka Mayumi) is a Japanese voice actress for . Her most famous role is that of .

==Biography==
Iizuka was born on January 3, 1977 in , . She began her career as an actor when she was three years old, but after she got her first voice acting role in the anime Omoide Poroporo, she went into a voice acting and singing career. She joined the at the very start of and voiced a number of characters, most notably . Iizuka has said that out of all her Pokémon roles, Misty is most like her. She got the part after the director told her to be herself during her audition.
